summary: Every objective received a significance weight (reach, magnitude, breadth of government, fiscal scale), scored blind by two independent AI raters with substantial agreement (quadratic-weighted kappa 0.80 to 0.92) and one third-rater adjudication; the weighted share in effect is shown under the headline with its range. 69 objectives with an unknown estimated window received a reasoned window labeled as an inference. 13 records had event citations moved to the primary document for the date. A derived court-status field was added to 51 records with court events, cross-references were added between overlapping objectives, and each chapter gained a short summary drawn from its records. No status changed.
title: Significance weights, estimated windows, court status, cross-references and chapter summaries
